scope: Independent read-only source review and byte-hash verification. No tests, imports of model/scientific modules, NN, images, rays, rendering or data mutation were performed.

resolved_finding.problem: Original array objects alone failed to notice geometry attribute replacement; a derived with_reference_sun object could differ from the original geometry consumed by common_pose.
resolved_finding.resolution: The final frontend binds GeometryOwnerGuardV84 before any reference-Sun/known-Sun derivation and checks the original owner in an outer finally spanning response on/off, errors and early returns. PairResponseCacheV84 additionally checks its derived live owner identities and hashes. Changed replacement geometry cannot be silently used by final PnP while response snapshots stay old.
regressions_read_not_executed: equal/different-byte final-estimator replacements with and without reference_sun override
original-owner replacement on blank-image early return

reviewed_invariants: Exact cache keys include native query measurement bytes, full trial pose bytes, selected Sun tuple and immutable model identity; no rounded pose/location/lighting keys.

Response cache uses private reference/query/geometry snapshots. Canonical surfaces, pairs and feature/prediction caches remain per case and bounded. Reference features remain original two-patch batches.
Tensor parameter/buffer identity, mode, dtype/device and version signatures detect regular changes; final full state digest detects .data writes before a response-enabled result escapes.

Response finish runs before successful return and on failure; solver acquisition finish is in finally. InferenceResultCapture clears before delegate entry, so exceptions cannot export a prior successful result.

Acquisition cache memoizes only exact static world-to-camera xy/front projections. Current query positions, shared/independent Sun assignments, solar states/materialization and hypothesis weights are recomputed on every acquisition. Pose/live-state changes alter keys; world/action/intrinsics changes fail the boundary check.
Old factory defaults and initialization-specific revisions remain intact. Cached variants require explicit revision; all new cache sources enter the evaluation source closure.

The copied solver retains candidate assignments, scoring, acquisition-policy choice, sampling order, AP3P/LM scheduling, three-pixel threshold and final common estimator. Existing source-level AST guards and procedural equality cases were read; their execution is owned by the parent.

timing_and_claims.note: Use the outer evaluation inference_seconds/case calendar for speed claims. The outer original-owner finally executes after the returned internal elapsed_seconds was computed, but before the delegate returns to the evaluation timer.

limits: Static review does not replace the parent full suite and fresh procedural image smoke. No lunar inference or performance result was produced.
Concurrent external mutation is forbidden; this review does not treat arbitrary monkeypatching/private-cache tampering as supported execution.
Caching is a versioned software optimization, not a new learned contribution or proof of correct Sun/pose recovery.
